windows_evidence: The 100368-byte .bin begins with the complete, byte-identical 100352-byte EXE and ends in sixteen 0x10 bytes. The executable behavior is identical; the AutoIt collector names are not identity evidence.

Entry 0x405738 calls 0x410a7c. Configuration reader 0x40549d locates .bss; 0x4053aa reads a length-prefixed key, and 0x4053f7 calls the RC4 transform at 0x405b00. A 50-byte key at file offset 99844 decrypts configuration from offset 99894. The first length-prefixed UTF-16 hostname is wealth.warzonedns.com; the following DWORD port is 5202. Configured filename is images.exe. The receive routine 0x4050cc uses recv, warzone160 and the same RC4 routine before handing packets to its virtual callback. The reconnect loop at 0x40496d calls connection and receive handlers.

Low-level keyboard-hook setup near 0x407488 installs type 13. Callback 0x4074d5 formats keys and modifiers, including ENTER/CRLF, and records them with foreground-window context; write helpers supply storage. This is recording rather than a bare hook import.

Chrome extraction 0x40adbb copies Login Data to a temporary file, selects the logins table, reads SQLite columns and calls CryptUnprotectData at 0x40afab. Mozilla code resolves NSS authentication/decryption entry points and handles encryptedUsername/encryptedPassword in logins.json. Outlook registry paths and POP3/SMTP password values lead to calls of the DPAPI helper at 0x409150 from 0x408db8.

Account routine 0x40c442 creates HKLM Winlogon\SpecialAccounts\UserList and writes a zero DWORD at 0x40c662. It passes the same generated username and password to 0x40b55d, which calls NetUserAdd and then NetLocalGroupAddMembers. This supports concealed retained access, not ordinary principal enumeration.

Persistence helpers construct a CurrentVersion Run path and value at 0x40ee3f-0x40ee76; 0x40ec15 copies the install file and writes the registry value through 0x40eb18. The uninstallation routine 0x40f020 removes its autorun value, calls GetModuleFileNameA, appends that path to cmd /C ping ... & Del /f /q, launches CreateProcessA with CREATE_NO_WINDOW, and exits. Existing neutral command/deletion and Run-key/API traits already describe these operations.

Process injection path 0x40f628 chooses a newly created hidden cmd process under WOW64 or another selected process; 0x40f6ed opens it, allocates/writes remote buffers, adjusts permissions and calls CreateRemoteThread. Existing neutral memory/thread traits are retained; the former game-reference description had no required game clue.

The embedded PE at file offset 0x14a70 has entry 0x401450. Its non-admin branch drops a resource as dismcore.dll and writes an unattended servicing XML, rewrites PEB process-parameter identities to Explorer, binds the elevated FileOperation class with CoGetObject, calls CopyItem/PerformOperations vtable slots and launches system pkgmgr.exe. These are the elevated DLL staging and trusted loader surface, beyond a generic elevation request.

The nested DLL at file offset 0x162e0 enters at 0x10001000, reads an install path from HKCU registry, enumerates/terminates the matching process, and launches the installed image via CreateProcessW. It supplies the relaunch stage of the elevation helper. Both embedded images were carved using PE section raw extents and disassembled.

RDP configuration routines reference TermService, ServiceDll, fDenyTSConnections, EnableConcurrentSessions and AllowMultipleTSSessions alongside registry/service modification. New neutral value-name traits make those specific controls visible without claiming that their mere names enable RDP.
windows_balance: Configured covert keyboard recording, multi-application password decryption, concealed local-account creation and an embedded elevation/relaunch chain outweigh the possibility of generic remote-administration use. The verdict does not depend on VT votes. Runtime success and incident deployment history were not supplied.
npm_evidence: All archive members were inspected: package/index.js and package/package.json only. postinstall runs node index.js; loading main index.js also executes the same top-level code. There are no external package dependencies.

The script constructs {event: install, host: os.hostname(), ts: ISO timestamp}; serializes it to JSON, Base64-encodes it, and interpolates the encoded value into the d query of a fixed HTTPS ngrok canary URL. Empty response and error callbacks discard both response and failure. No environment variables, credentials or file bytes are read; no remote response is executed, no persistence or payload staging occurs.

The manifest description explicitly says Dependency Confusion to RCE By Steiner254. RCE here is the local package lifecycle execution, not a remote command handler. The complete implementation is an install callback, with no event-hunting library API or caller-controlled diagnostic operation.

The exact external react-native-bright-sdk 9000.0.0 artifact was recovered with forager and hash verified as f62375459c326e0dd0377c9035854a7ed63c7d7457142773f4bf99d248f5d472. Its preinstall canary has the same hostname/timestamp/Base64/GET data path and endpoint; its description claims namespace reservation/self-testing. This establishes a plausible research origin, not authorization for event-hunter on a third-party machine. Its original host-output capability and a postinstall variant retain detection in the focused controls.
npm_balance: MALICIOUS on the supplied evidence: the only functionality is an automatically executed, operator-directed host-identifying dependency-confusion callback, and the manifest explicitly advertises the attack. A sanctioned namespace test is plausible, but target ownership, install authorization and deployment history are absent; disclosure is not evidence of consent. This is an install canary, not a credential stealer or general remote-code command channel.
corrections: Renamed the remote-memory composite to remove an unsupported game claim. Its matcher, platform/type scope, suspicious severity and all exclusions are byte-for-byte semantically preserved; existing regression consumers were updated.

Moved three npm callbacks from lifecycle/supply-chain carrier branches into host-identity exfiltration or OOB callback homes. Host-export variants now require a structured host/user-to-GET URL origin (and Buffer/Base64-to-URL origin for the encoded variant). Local encoding and an unrelated/fixed URL no longer establish export. No endpoint, author, package filename or unique hash was added as a matcher.

The former generic rule also accepted a passwd-file source. Kept that technique as a separate source-bound account-db export rule, instead of losing it during hostname-flow tightening. Both the existing host/user OAST positive fixture and passwd export control pass.
The callback-only rule retains all its match conditions and hostile severity, but no longer claims system discovery via T1082: it does not require a hostname read.

Audited the full 100-rule account/create leaf. Relocated its Go net-user command-literal atom to the neutral account capability home, preserving matcher, scope, suspicious severity, exclusions and its exact RAT consumer; this is a placement correction, not a directory split or budget increase.

Added supported concealed-account, Outlook-password and FileOperation/pkgmgr elevation composites plus neutral RC4, registry value/key, COM and path observations. Existing accurate detections and third-party identities remain untouched.

coverage_summary.npm_distinct_behavior_limit: Three retained hostile rule variants describe one actual install/callback outcome. Intensive inspection of both members and the full response/error paths found no further distinct hostile behavior to detect. No shell, payload activation, persistence, credential theft or obfuscation was invented to reach a distinct-behavior quota.
coverage_summary.material_detection_losses: None on supplied samples after the recorded relocations. In near misses, the two unsupported host-export convictions disappear while the independent dependency-confusion callback finding remains when its label is present. The ordinary fixed-status control has zero hostile and suspicious traits.
coverage_summary.remaining_classifier_disagreement: event-hunter remains BENIGN at the default classifier operating point (L15000), before and after, despite three accurate hostile rules. Live final tiny output confirms scan benign confidence=0.999 fp-level=L15000. PE samples remain scan hostile confidence=0.980 fp-level=L25. No duplicate or inaccurate score-raising rules were added.
coverage_summary.scan_limitations: The engine reports source-local flow limitations/anonymous callbacks for the JavaScript. The entire short script and callbacks were manually traced. Model v18 feature-spec warning is preserved as a model limitation, not evidence about behavior.

checks.consumer_audit: No YAML exact consumers of the three relocated npm IDs were found. Their source ancestor selectors were searched; no broad rule reference requiring migration was identified. Go exact RAT consumer and existing memory regression mapping/check were updated. Semantic equivalence of memory and Go matcher/scope/severity/exclusions was asserted against git HEAD.
